card.line: Sharon was a rich, fertile region known for its pasturelands, and the Bible names it as a place where the tribes east of the Jordan lived and kept their flocks.

moments.title: Tribes live in Sharon's pastures
moments.text: The Gadites lived in Gilead, in Bashan and its towns, and throughout the pasturelands of Sharon. Their families were recorded in the genealogies in the days of Jotham and Jeroboam.
